name: graphql-dashboard-integration

states.name: Mutation-Backed Lifecycle Controls
states.description: The dashboard control bar's stop, pause, and resume actions use GraphQL mutations. The mutation result automatically updates the cache.

states.name: Subscription-Driven Updates
states.description: Dashboard data refreshes when events arrive via subscription, not on a fixed polling interval.

states.name: Orchestration Loop Banner
states.description: A banner appears at the top of the dashboard when an orchestration loop is running. Shows phase, iteration progress, and control buttons. Phase updates are driven by a GraphQL subscription.

states.name: Connection Health Badge
states.description: The bottom bar shows a connection status indicator powered by a GraphQL health subscription. Falls back to REST polling if the subscription is unavailable.

description: GraphQL Dashboard Integration — the Active Dashboard's stop/pause/resume controls use GraphQL mutations. The orchestration loop banner uses a GraphQL subscription for phase detection. The connection health badge uses a health subscription. Dashboard data refreshes are triggered by subscription events rather than blind polling.
